what: A black liquid spreads behind the screen — in a feedback buffer that reads and rewrites the previous frame, while the cursor moves (until 50ms after it stops) a brush stroke of radius .08~.12 (share of screen height) is painted along the path just traveled, flowed by a noise angle field at height 1.85px per step and dried at .95 per second (fixed 1/120s steps, at most 4 steps per frame). The visible screen is dressed from the height field gradient with back light .3, reflection to the 20th power .5 and a rainbow edge rim, with grain dither .1 subtracted, and the background is a round glow bright at the center (.7× brightness). At first a noise blob (radius 1.3) blooms at the center and shrinks over 3s expo.inOut. Press and hold an empty spot for 1s (power2.inOut) and the moment it passes .75 the plate flips so the background darkens, the rainbow rim spreads across the whole liquid, and a .85s power3.out glitch (horizontal slice shifts and color offsets) runs once — release early and it returns, hold again and it comes back from below .25. [data-fx-part=target] When the cursor is over a row, liquid spreads sideways from the cursor spot to fill that row’s box (the box grows over 2.6s from a cursor-height band and gathers into a band at the bottom 30% of the row at 1.1s, all in one expo.out). When it leaves the row, it dries twice as fast over 1s. Sending fx:shock makes a shockwave ring that splits along the grain from that spot (1.5s power3.out, width .07) and spreads to the screen edge, pushing the liquid and darkening and bending the ring area

options.layer: fixed (default — behind the whole screen, all lines below the attached element as target) · box (only inside the attached element, z 0)
options.intro: Duration (s) for the first blooming blob to shrink in, default 3 — 0 for none
options.wait: if ready, enters when fx:ready is sent (when the loader clears). Default is right after the delay
options.hold-dur: Press length for the panel flip (seconds), default 1
options.dpr: Max drawing resolution (multiplier), default 2 — 1 on touch devices
options.--fx-lo · --fx-hi · --fx-shine: Dark (liquid · inverted background) · light at the center of the background · reflected light, defaults --kf-contrast-bg · --kf-raised · --kf-contrast-ink
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Drawing board — build one if missing
options.[data-fx-part=target]: Lines the liquid fills in (list rows or cards)
options.fx:shock: detail {x, y, strength} — One shockwave at a screen coordinate (up to four at once)
options.fx:toggle: Flips the panel without a press (switch modes with a button)
options.fx:hold · fx:mode: Emits press progress (0~1, also used for the element’s --fx-hold) · flipped (0|1) — the consumer applies the background color and text blending

note: Load THREE first as a global (_vendor/three@0.186.0/three.min.js). Instead of the original’s two noise images, per-cell random RGB (flow) and horizontally smeared gray grain (dither · shockwave) are baked on the spot. Touch devices turn off press and follow the cursor with 1−e^(−9dt), resolution 1x. With reduced motion, no GL, only a round blurred background

from.where: index.html body — original BlackLiquidWEBGL (three r186, two feedback buffers + a visible panel, iHold·iGlitch·iShocks·iTargetRect)
